inputs.text: More tenancies mean little if people are still ending up in emergency accommodation and families are worried about eviction. Micheál Martin can point to lease figures, but security is what matters. Forcing landlords into six-year leases from March 1 may sound compassionate, yet piling on rules risks driving ordinary providers out and leaving renters with fewer options. Government should focus on stable homes for families, not headline numbers and policies that make the housing market harder to navigate.
